add_copyright_header: add a Boost Software License copyright header to a C++ hpp file
add_include_guard: add an ifndef define endif include guard to a C++ hpp file
run_boilerplate_script: run the add_boilerplate script on an hpp file to add copyright and include guards
generate_guard_name: generate a BOOST prefixed include guard name from a file path
review_boilerplate_logic: review the add_boilerplate script logic for copyright and include guard insertion
